about: Held-out intent cases. Written AFTER the routing rules in lib/services/intent_router.dart were finalised, and the rules were not modified in response to the result. This is the only intent number in the repository that is not an upper bound -- eval/intent_queries.json was visible while the rules were being written, so a high score there means the rules cover the cases the author thought of, not that the router works. Phrasings here are deliberately varied: indirect requests, non-questions, and vocabulary absent from the rule lists.
